page.overview:
Who is Department of Fire?

The is a department in Heaven responsible for the governing of fire. It is led by the Fire Star.

When Sun Wukong was to be executed, the Old Man of the South Pole ordered the Department of Fire to burn him to death, but it was unable to kill him.

Later, Sun Wukong went up to Red Aura Palace to seek the help of the Fire Star and the Department of Fire after being defeated by the Single Horned Rhinoceros King. The department attacked the demon with fire, but the Rhinoceros King absorbed it all with the Diamond Cutter.
